senses.gloss: ch. same, to tie a shoe. Part. pass. נָעִיל, נְעִיל.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 25:9">Targ. Y. Deut. XXV, 9</cite> <he>ויהא נ׳ וכ׳</he> and there shall be tied on the foot … a sandal which &c.
Targ. II Chr. XXVIII, 15. [Dan. II, 25, a. e. הַנְעִל to bring up, fr. עֲלַל.]
